artifact.tla:
VARIABLES pc, g

vars == << pc, g >>

ProcSet == {1}

Init == /\ g = 0
        /\ pc = [self \in ProcSet |-> "L"]

L == /\ pc[1] = "L"
     /\ g' = g + 1
     /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![1] = "E"]

E == /\ pc[1] = "E"
     /\ TRUE
     /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![1] = "Done"]
     /\ g' = g

P == L \/ E

Terminating == /\ \A self \in ProcSet: pc[self] = "Done"
               /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == P \/ Terminating

Spec == /\ Init /\ [][Next]_vars
        /\ WF_vars(Next)

Termination == <>(\A self \in ProcSet: pc[self] = "Done")
